reference: PointNet++ (NeurIPS 2017), section 3.2; author pointnet_util.py sample_and_group and pointnet_sa_module
primary_comparison: local vs pointwise_xyz with exactly equal trainable parameters and identical decoder
secondary_comparison: existing wide MLP; additional 384 encoder parameters in both new variants
selection: best per-run validation CD squared; summarize using common evaluation sampling seed43
adaptation: one local set abstraction plus global max; exact kNN including anchor rather than fixed-radius ball; 32/16 are frozen engineering budget choices, not paper-optimal settings; no BN/MSG/feature propagation; canonical FPS nearest-hole start; region units divided by hole radius
loss: CD squared divided by hole radius squared only; no repulsion or edge loss
scope: fixed 2 validation objects; no test-set access; reference meshes for evaluation only
quality_scope: all 40 validation holes for seed42 variants; three training seeds CD and F-score
limitations: not a full PointNet++ reproduction or a claim of statistically significant generalization
